Vendor Registration Status

Approval Status

Pending

Vendor Status

Pending

After registration, the vendor is automatically created with Approval Status = Pending and Vendor Status = Pending. Authorized users can later approve or reject the vendor through the Vendor Approval Workflow. Vendors become available for Procurement only when:

  • Approval Status = Approved
  • Vendor Status = Active

Backend Validation

FastAPI validates vendor information before saving to PostgreSQL.

  • Company Name should not be duplicated (business rule if enabled).
  • Email Address must be unique.
  • GST Number must be unique.
  • PAN Number must be unique.
  • Company Registration Number must be unique.

Audit information such as Created By, Created Date, Last Updated By, Last Updated Date, Approved By, and Approved Date will be generated automatically by the backend.
